Package com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.dbc

Purpose of this package is to host all Quote data beans that are implemented specifically for DBCAPI.

See: Description

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    DbcCallQuoteRequestFilter
    To reduce the option chains for Call only.
    DbcMonthYearQuoteRequestFilter
    This Filter is very important for DBCAPI options chain requests.
    DbcPutQuoteRequestFilter
    To reduce the option chains for Put only.
    DbcQuoteRequestFilterUtil
    This utility was added to provide syntax specifically used by DBCAPI during filter requests.
    DbcStrangeQuoteRequestFilter
    This filter should be utilized in conjuction with DbcStrikeQuoteRequestFilter to define upper or lower limit on the Strike values.
    DbcStrikeQuoteRequestFilter
    Purpose of this filter is to reduce the response by Strike value.
    DbcUnderlierQuoteRequestFilter
    This filter returns a superset of DbcMonthYearQuoteRequestFilter in case of futures options requests.
    DbcVolumeQuoteRequestFilter
    Purpose of this value is filter the contracts based on Volume value.
